headline: Executive order bans certain dealings with UNITA, an armed rebel group in Angola.
what_it_does: This order bars certain kinds of transactions involving UNITA, a rebel group that was fighting the government of Angola. The title does not say which transactions are covered. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, penalties, and exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: US companies and individuals doing business connected to UNITA
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from certain transactions involving the group.
Their ability to carry out certain dealings that involve the United States is restricted.
